subject: Request: temporary allowance for regional replication lag during DR switchover
messages:
From: Jordan Evans <jordan.evans@greenbank.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Temporary allowance request for replication lag during DR switchover

Rafael / Redwood team —

Quick background: we run a geo-active cluster across eu-west and eu-north. During the last scheduled warm-standby switchover your infra team initiated (2025-05-28), we observed replication lag spikes that pushed our observed RPO from ~15s to ~4m for a handful of services. That caused a handful of reconciliation jobs to fail and required manual intervention from our SREs.

We understand the need for controlled switchover behavior, but we need a short-term contractual allowance that permits up to 5 minutes RPO during planned cross-region activation windows (up to 30 minutes per occurrence, max 4 occurrences/month) while you roll out the prioritized KV cache improvements you mentioned in the runbook.

Specifically we are asking for:
- A written, timeboxed carveout to allow RPO up to 5 minutes during an agreed maintenance/warm-standby activation window.
- An SLA adjustment note for these activation windows indicating no credit will be applied for RPO breaches within the carveout.
- Monthly sync metrics and a post-activation report for the pilot period (2 months).

We are prepared to accept an extended RTO (from 10 minutes to 25 minutes) only for the activation window if Redwood provides the mitigation plan and the checkpoint metrics after each activation.

Attached: short extract from our incident runbook and the replication metrics from 2025-05-28.

Can you confirm next steps and whether Legal/Compliance needs anything from us?

Thanks,
Jordan Evans
Senior SRE — GreenBank Financial
attachments: repl_metrics_q2.pdf
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Evans <jordan.evans@greenbank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary allowance request for replication lag during DR switchover

Jordan — thanks for the concise note and the metrics. Apologies for the disruption your team saw; we can absolutely propose a short, timeboxed concession while we finish the KV cache change rollout and deploy the new continuous-batching scheduler to the eu clusters.

High-level response / proposal here: 
- Pilot period: 60 days starting 2025-07-01. During the pilot we will accept an RPO allowance up to 5 minutes for scheduled activation windows limited to 30 minutes/event, max 4 events per calendar month.
- RTO: we will accept extended RTO up to 25 minutes for the activation window only (production SLA outside those windows remains unchanged).
- Observability: Redwood will provide an activation report within 48 hours of each switchover (latency histogram, replication tail, KV cache hit/miss rates).
- Credits/penalties: during the pilot period we propose no automatic SLA credits for RPO breaches that fall within the carveout; if an event exceeds the carveout parameters we will evaluate credits per standard dispute process.

Next steps from our side: I will loop Legal and Security to confirm agreement language and any evidence they require. From an engineering side, Jonas will schedule a short runbook walkthrough with your SRE team to align on activation steps and observability hooks.

Jonas / Kimberly — can you confirm the technical feasibility of the 48-hour report cadence and whether Security wants any supplemental documentation (e.g., change log for the KV cache rollout)?

Jordan — if you can confirm the pilot start date (we proposed 2025-07-01) and that GreenBank agrees to the 4-event/month cap, I’ll route this for Legal.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Evans <jordan.evans@greenbank.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary allowance request for replication lag during DR switchover

Rafael / Jonas — quick technical + compliance note.

Technical: the proposed 5-minute RPO allowance during scheduled activation windows is technically achievable as a documented carveout if we: (a) gate the activation on a coordinated runbook trigger, (b) enable prefix caching and pre-warm paths for the top 50 request signatures, and (c) run a pre-switchover validation that ensures cross-region write buffers are drained within 60s prior to the switch. We will instrument an automated report for the metrics Rafael flagged; the 48-hour turnaround is doable but requires a small ops playbook to collect and redact customer-identifying request IDs for the report.

Compliance/Legal: I’ve flagged this to Security. Two asks from them before Legal will sign off: 
- A statement from GreenBank that they will not run regulatory reconciliation in the activation window (i.e., no final settlement jobs).
- Acceptance of temporary log-retention changes: we may need to retain high-frequency replication trace logs for an additional 14 days for forensic purposes during the pilot.

I’ll draft the technical appendix for the carveout and the evidence checklist (change logs, pre-warm run outputs). Rafael — once Jordan confirms the pilot dates I’ll drop the appendix and the supporting runbook into the Doc link Rafael referenced.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Reliability Engineering — Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Evans <jordan.evans@greenbank.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 14:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary allowance request for replication lag during DR switchover

Thanks — Rafa and Kim, this looks reasonable and aligns with our SRE tolerance. GreenBank confirms:
- Pilot start date 2025-07-01, 60-day duration.
- We accept the 4 events/month cap and the 30-minute activation window per event.
- We will not run final settlement/reconciliation jobs during the activation windows and will coordinate schedules with your SRE leads.
- We acknowledge possible temporary extension of log retention for the pilot as requested.

Please send the appendix and the short carveout language so our legal team can review. Once we get the draft we’ll turn it around within 72 hours.

Jordan Evans
Senior SRE — GreenBank Financial
attachments: acknowledgement_signed.pdf
